attributes.action: The rules about pets ashes being buried with their owners is very outdated
attributes.additional_details: I would like the uk government  to review the current rules over pet not allowed  to be laid to rest with their owner, As long as the pet is cremated why cant their remains be buried in the same plot as their family ( owner)
attributes.background: Many pet owners wish their beloved pet to be laid to rest with them, the curren rules this is not allowed, The rule is very much out dated, It should be reviewed as pets are family to

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on the steps that might need to be taken for the Government to make this happen, which you may wish to sign:

https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775921
